scope: Real CoreStore and DaemonCore with FakeDriver and a counting I1 callback. No real process or durable I1 callback write. Public API creates then deletes each cohort Bee and all its mail while one overdue anchor stays pending throughout. Private Set cardinalities are diagnostic observations, not a new production API. Post-GC heapUsed is process retained JavaScript heap, not private/RSS memory or exact Set bytes. DB audit history remains durable. Per-step process CPU/wall samples cover new-violation, already-reported, cohort-deleted, and256settling steps; setup/GC/assertions excluded. Independent process-order repeats, not within-process paired timing. Native memory snapshot is separate from step timing.
